fetchError.title: Scheduler data could not be loaded
fetchError.fallback: Failed to load scheduler data. The backend may be unreachable.

dialog.editDescription: Change the schedule, command, or target server for "{{name}}".
dialog.createDescription: Run a command on a schedule.
dialog.timezoneNotice: Times below run in the panel's timezone: {{tz}}
dialog.cronFormatHint: Format: minute hour day month weekday
dialog.commandTip: This runs unattended on the schedule above, with no confirmation each time it fires. Pick something safe to repeat automatically -- a custom command isn't checked against a safe list, and it keeps running until you disable or delete this task.
dialog.bridgeFormatHint: Format: <1>bridge:<action> {json args}</1> — e.g. <2>bridge:triggerBlizzard {"durationHours":2}</2>. Args are optional. Only allow-listed actions run via the scheduler.
dialog.targetServerHelp: This task always runs against this server, even if a different one is active when it fires.

manualRestart.title: Manual Restart
manualRestart.descRunning: Pick a countdown — players are warned and the server restarts when it ends.
manualRestart.descOffline: Server is offline — start it before issuing a restart.
manualRestart.restartIn15Title: Restart in 15 minutes with countdown warnings
manualRestart.restartIn10Title: Restart in 10 minutes with countdown warnings
manualRestart.restartIn5Title: Restart in 5 minutes with countdown warnings
manualRestart.restartIn1Title: Restart in 1 minute — short warning, requires confirmation
manualRestart.restartIn1DialogDesc: Players get a single 1-minute warning before the server goes down. Use longer countdowns if anyone is mid-fight or driving.
manualRestart.noPermission: Restarting the server requires the server.control permission, which this role doesn't have.
manualRestart.shortCountdownDialogDesc: Short countdowns can catch players mid-action. Confirm if you really want to restart this fast.
manualRestart.countdownWarningsNote: Players see countdown warnings at 15m, 10m, 5m, and 1m as the timer ticks down.

quickBroadcasts.title: Quick Broadcasts
quickBroadcasts.descRunning: Send common announcements to all players.
quickBroadcasts.descOffline: Server is offline — broadcasts require a running server.

broadcastMessages.maintenanceStart: Server entering MAINTENANCE MODE - Please save and disconnect
broadcastMessages.maintenanceEnd: Maintenance complete - Server is back online!
broadcastMessages.saveWarning: Server will save in 30 seconds - Brief lag expected
broadcastMessages.welcome: Welcome! Please read the rules at spawn

scheduledTasks.title: Scheduled Tasks
scheduledTasks.emptyDesc: Create a task to run commands automatically.
scheduledTasks.deleteDialogDesc: Are you sure you want to delete "{{name}}"? This action cannot be undone.

executionHistory.title: Execution History
executionHistory.clearDialogDesc_one: Are you sure you want to clear ALL execution history? This removes every recorded run, not just the {{count}} shown here. This action cannot be undone.
executionHistory.clearDialogDesc_other: Are you sure you want to clear ALL execution history? This removes every recorded run, not just the {{count}} shown here. This action cannot be undone.
executionHistory.truncatedHint: Showing the most recent {{count}} runs -- older executions may not be shown.

timezone.title: Scheduler Timezone
timezone.description: Every schedule below -- your tasks, the automatic backup, and auto-restart -- runs in this timezone.
timezone.fallbackTitle: Saved timezone is no longer valid
timezone.fallbackDesc: "{{configured}}" could not be used (it may have been removed from the timezone database, or this panel was restored from a different machine). Schedules are running in {{effective}} until this is fixed.

restartWarning.title: Restart Warnings
restartWarning.description: Automatic restart countdown messages sent to every connected player.
restartWarning.templateHint: Use {count} for the number and {unit} for minutes or seconds.

toasts.restartInitiatedWithWarningsDesc_one: Server will restart in {{minutes}} minute with countdown warnings
toasts.restartInitiatedWithWarningsDesc_other: Server will restart in {{minutes}} minutes with countdown warnings
toasts.restartMinutesClampedDesc: You entered {{requested}} minutes, but the warning countdown is capped at {{applied}}. Server will restart in {{applied}} minutes instead.
